description.text: Software engineering is an engineering discipline that studies the design, development, testing, maintenance and management of software systems. It applies systematic, standardized and measurable methods throughout the entire lifecycle of software, aiming to address core issues such as "high software complexity, low development efficiency and difficult quality assurance". From operating systems, mobile apps to artificial intelligence algorithms and aerospace control systems, the achievements of software engineering support the digital operation of modern society.

duration.text: The Software engineering at Xidian University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1: Applicants must not have aChinese nationality.2:Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental diseasethat would have impact on the normal study), and must abide by Chinese laws and regulations, as well as XidianUniversity's school rules and regulations, and respect China's social morals and customs.3:Applicants must be at least 18 years old.4:Language competency 1) lELTS score of 6.5 or above 2)TOEFLscore of 80 or above 3)Duolingo score of105 or above 4)Applicants with a previous degree taughtin English may be exempted from providingEnglish language test scores if theyprovide relevant proof.
